# sameep.ai/make

> Make your own sameep.ai: a portfolio where your CV burns onto a CD and an iMac plays a podcast about
> your work, in your voice. Say one sentence to your Claude (with Wispr): "make your own sameep.ai using
> your GitHub profile".

The full agent guide is https://sameep.ai/llms.txt . The Claude Code skill (instructions + scripts) is
https://sameep.ai/skill/off-the-cv/SKILL.md ; install it with:

    curl -fsSL https://sameep.ai/skill/off-the-cv/install.sh | sh
